sources.citation: Martin, Milisavljevic & Drissen (2021), 3D mapping of the Crab Nebula with SITELLE. I
Pinned common ICRS image-frame origin derived from registered observations; adopted display centre, not a measured nebular centroid.

introduction.text: The Crab combines an expanding supernova remnant with a pulsar wind nebula. It lies about 2,000 parsecs away.

distance.method: Adopted 2 kpc reconstruction scale from Martin et al. (2021), section 3.4, following Trimble (1973). The cited 1.7–2.4 kpc range is not a statistical error. Lin et al. (2023) independently find 1.90 −0.18/+0.22 kpc; no distance refit is applied.

classification.name: Supernova remnant and pulsar wind nebula
classification.basis: Released SITELLE ejecta samples use a conditional expansion-to-depth model; a separate published torus interpretation and authored jets describe the pulsar wind. Spectral display colors are not calibrated gas or dust density.
